script_name.description: The main Python script file to bundle

dist_path.description: Directory where the final bundle will be placed

app_name.description: Name of the generated executable and spec file

spec_path.description: Directory to store the generated .spec file

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR)

onefile_mode.description: True to create a single executable file, False for a directory bundle

upx_dir.description: Path to UPX executable directory (empty to search PATH)

clean_build.description: True to clean cache and temp files before building

add_data.description: List of data files/dirs to add. Each item is a map with 'src' and 'dest'. Format: 'source:dest_dir'. Use FLAT map in schema for items.

add_data_items.description: Schema for items in add_data list (not used directly in JSON values, but defined for schema compliance if needed, though template uses inline iteration). Note: Per instructions, list items are FLAT map. I will define the item schema separately if required, but Jinja2 iteration handles it. The schema 'add_data' is list. The items are objects. I need to define the item structure in the schema if I were validating, but here I just need the schema for the root vars. Wait, instruction says: 'For a list-of-objects, add items as a FLAT map field-name -> {type, default, description}'. So I must add 'add_data_items' to the root schema.

add_binaries.description: List of binary files to add. See add_data.

add_binary_items.description: Schema for items in add_binaries list

import_paths.description: Additional paths to search for Python modules

hidden_imports.description: Modules to import even if not found statically

collect_submodules.description: Packages to collect all submodules for

collect_data.description: Packages to collect all data files for

collect_binaries.description: Packages to collect all binaries for

collect_all.description: Packages to collect submodules, data, and binaries for

recursive_copy_metadata.description: Packages to recursively copy metadata for

runtime_hooks.description: Paths to custom runtime hook files

excludes.description: Modules to exclude from the bundle

python_options.description: Options to pass to the Python interpreter at runtime

strip_symbols.description: Strip symbols from executable and shared libs

no_upx.description: Do not use UPX for compression

upx_excludes.description: Binaries to exclude from UPX compression

windowed_mode.description: Run without a console window (on Windows/macOS)

icon_path.description: Path to icon file (.ico for Windows, .icns for macOS)

debug_options.description: Debug modes to enable (all, imports, bootloader, noarchive)

splash_file.description: Path to splash screen image file

osx_bundle_identifier.description: Bundle identifier for macOS apps (e.g., com.mycompany.app)

codesign_identity.description: Code signing identity for macOS apps
